tools.name: wait_for_human
tools.description: Block until the vision system sees a stable human pose in the camera view.

stable_seconds.description: How long the human must remain visible before returning.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait before returning a timeout.

tools.name: squat_counter
tools.description: Start or continue squat counting from pose estimation. Returns at squat counts 2 and 4, and ends the set at 4.

target_reps.description: Total squats to count before ending the set. Default is 4.

milestones.description: Rep counts where the tool should return to Gemma. Default is [2, 4].

reset.description: Start a new squat session even if one is already active.
